item.title: Man accused of setting fire during South Lubbock eviction
item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas -- Roderick Mainda, 41, was arrested on Thursday in connection with a residential fire in South Lubbock. Preliminary information from the Lubbock Fire Rescue Fire Marshal’s Office indicates the Lubbock County Constable was serving an eviction notice at the residence when the occupant, identified as Mainda intentionally started a fire inside the home. item.title: Boil water notice in effect for Petersburg residents
item.description: PETERSBURG, Texas -- The City of Petersburg has issued a boil water notice Friday morning following a water main break that occurred overnight. City officials said the break has been repaired, but the notice will remain in effect until water quality testing is completed and approved by the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality. item.title: Catherine O'Hara, star of 'Home Alone' and 'Schitt's Creek,' dies at 71
item.description: Renowned actress Catherine O'Hara has died at the age of 71, according to multiple reports.

item.title: Former 'person of interest' in Ysasaga case pleads guilty to federal meth charge
item.description: Christian Castro, a former person of interest in the Mark Ysasaga case, was sentenced to 12 years and 4 months in federal prison on an unrelated narcotics trafficking charge, while Jose Simental was served with a warrant for Ysasaga's murder and later pleaded guilty to Tampering with Evidence, receiving a 7 year sentence.

item.title: Bring out your inner artist at locally owned South Lubbock art studio
item.description: Colorful Creations Studios is a family-owned business in South Lubbock, near 130th Street and University Avenue. Ariana and Natasha Thomas, Aubree Gomez and their brother told Everythinglubbock.com they wanted to create a safe space for anyone to come and make art.

item.title: UCF blasts off, stuns No. 11 Texas Tech on the road
item.description: No. 11 Texas Tech rode into the Sunshine State fresh off a huge win over then-No. 6 Houston. Despite a week's worth of rest, the Red Raiders were outclassed by UCF in a stunning 88-79 upset loss.
